content.management: The guideline discusses management strategies for symptomatic peripheral artery disease (PAD), including structured exercise programs, endovascular revascularization, and adherence to supervised exercise therapy.
content.exercise_therapy: Supervised exercise therapy is emphasized as a key intervention for improving mobility and quality of life in people with PAD. The effectiveness of structured walking programs and resistance training is explored.
content.revascularization: Revascularization options are considered, including their effectiveness in various clinical scenarios. The role of invasive strategies such as aorto-iliac interventions and stenting is discussed.
content.other_interventions: The guideline also mentions the effects of lifestyle changes, adherence to treatment regimens, and the benefits of cardiorespiratory rehabilitation.
